cases.label: Full game 1
cases.selection: Selected fully audited held-out game with nonzero prior support through every recorded half-turn

selection: First eight held-out games with at least four supported early half-turn snapshots
board_note: Public end-of-half-turn battlefield snapshots. Tapping, counters, attachments, and exact action order are unavailable.

historical.label: Historical decks
historical.description: Interpretable finite-deck hand accounting. Uses 4,180 historical decks.

hand_size.label: Hand size only
hand_size.description: Historical deck frequencies and current hand size; ignores revealed cards.

smoothed_prior.label: Smoothed prior
smoothed_prior.description: Color and deck-shape mixture allowing unseen card combinations. Uses 4,096 training decks.

boosted_history.label: Trees · public history
boosted_history.description: Boosted trees using public hand movements, card metadata, and the smoothed prior. Raw probabilities.

boosted_board.label: Trees · history + board
boosted_board.description: Boosted trees also using public board counts, life totals, and land colors. Raw probabilities.

method_comparison_note: Selected replay demonstrations, not a new benchmark. All replay draft events are held out. Methods use different training pools and assumptions; boosted trees use raw, uncalibrated probabilities. Research models were evaluated on sampled states through turn 30; these displayed games are selected examples.
